e2bBehaviour.summary: A closed disclosure on the saved mission page, shown only when the books switch is on. No checkbox: the cannot-recall notice is shown above the buttons inside the panel, with the same sentence in the PDF. Two buttons, 'Download Trip Book (PDF)' and 'Download Supplier Book (PDF)'.
e2bBehaviour.retries: The same commandId is reused on retry and forgotten only on success, 409, 429 and a 422 with UNSUPPORTED_TEXT or EMPTY. 503, 404, other 5xx, timeouts and non-PDF answers keep the id. A 60 s client timeout shows 'could not confirm'. The object URL is revoked after 10 s.
e2bBehaviour.accessibility: An empty kind uses aria-disabled with a visible reason and keeps focus. A denial shows one dedicated alert and moves focus to it; a 401 adds a Sign in again link.
e2bBehaviour.copy: 27 English placeholder words (bookWords) marked D16 in all 7 catalogs; the language-review row reads 'Draft, review not yet recorded'. No native review exists.
e2bBehaviour.reviews: An adversarial review and a designer audit ran on eae5140 with no blocking defect. One real defect (a stale book denial shown on a later evidence-response denial, and pending ids not cleared) and several test gaps were found and fixed in f7caeb3.
